device_environment.geometry_admission: Use per-polarity geometry membership shared by every selected pinned continuous section; intersect with W<=100um, L>=0.15um. Do not use OTA device-role parameter names.

electrical_acceptance: All required DC and transient checks pass for one frozen submitted DUT; no weighted tradeoff between failed requirements.
packet_policy: Only the selected public specification, device use, methods, client and own results; no completed circuit, reference results or independent coordinates. Reuse existing sandbox/login; disable Web tools.
change_control: Implement these limits, not an easy-tier substitute. A necessary change requires native evidence, an explicit revised specification identity and a new frozen task before participant admission.
qualification_required: Pinned model closure and geometry/multiplicity correctness
One native feasible witness per technology on the entire required matrix
Independent raw re-extraction and a known failing circuit
Integrated capture, packet, planner, accounting and report checks
comparison_policy: Same task concept and measurement rules; task-specific electrical calibration. No equal difficulty or cross-process score claim.
